subject: gap-q4
method: measured gap per capability, mapped to the intervention that addresses that capability

bands.note: Bands apply to the local model's own score on a 0 to 1 scale, not to the gap.

dimensions.label: End state reached
dimensions.failure_mode: The model ends the episode without producing the state the task asked for.
intervention: Supervised trajectories that end in a verified state, filtered so only runs the verifier passed are kept.
Preference pairs built from the model's own failed attempt against a successful trace of the same task.
Rejection sampling on the task suite, with the verifier as the reward, once supervised format is stable.
dimensions.recipe: verifier-filtered trajectory supervision, then verifier-as-reward optimisation

evidence.note: Counts every task in the suite.

data_estimate.note: At or near the reference on this capability; spend the budget on the weaker ones.

dimensions.label: Action expressible
dimensions.failure_mode: Turns arrive as prose, as several objects, or as a schema the loop cannot read.
intervention: Supervision on short single-object actions with the exact key names the loop accepts.
Negative examples pairing a malformed turn with its corrected form, so the model learns the boundary and not just the target.
A constrained decoding grammar at inference time, which is a runtime fix and not a training fix.

evidence.note: Counts every task in the suite.

data_estimate.note: At or near the reference on this capability; spend the budget on the weaker ones.

dimensions.label: Tool and arguments valid
dimensions.failure_mode: The call names a tool that does not exist, or omits an argument the tool requires.
intervention: Supervision grounded in the tool registry, so every name and argument in the data is one the runtime accepts.
Hard negatives drawn from near miss names, which is where a small model drifts.
A schema validator wired into the loop that returns the schema in the error, so the correction is learnable in context too.

evidence.note: Counts every task in the suite.

data_estimate.note: At or near the reference on this capability; spend the budget on the weaker ones.

dimensions.label: Recovery after a failed call
dimensions.failure_mode: An error is returned and the next turn repeats the same call or abandons the task.
intervention: Trajectories that contain a real error and the successful turn that follows it, taken from the failures this run recorded.
Preference pairs where the chosen turn differs from the rejected turn after an identical error.
Deliberate environment perturbation during data collection, because an error-free corpus teaches nothing here.
dimensions.recipe: error-conditioned trajectory data, mined from real failures

evidence.note: Counts only the tasks that produced an error to recover from, because that is the only place this capability is observable.

data_estimate.note: Treated as absent, so the plan is to teach the behaviour from format upward rather than to sharpen it.

dimensions.label: Calls spent
dimensions.failure_mode: The task is solved but only after repeated or unnecessary calls, or the budget runs out first.
intervention: Preference pairs over solutions to the same task where the shorter successful path is preferred.
Step budget pressure during collection, so the demonstration distribution is not padded.

evidence.note: Counts every task in the suite.

data_estimate.note: Treated as weak, so the plan is to sharpen a behaviour that already appears sometimes.

stage_one.name: Supervised fine tune on verified trajectories
stage_one.why: Trajectories rather than single turns, because the failures measured here are about what the model does after its own earlier output.

stage_two.name: Preference optimisation over the same tasks
stage_two.why: Format is already fixed by stage one, so the remaining signal is which of two plausible continuations actually ends in a verified state.

stage_three.name: On-policy optimisation against the task verifier
stage_three.when: Only after stage one and two plateau, and only while the verifier stays ahead of the policy.
stage_three.why: The verifier is the only reward available without a human, and it is already written for every task in this suite.

evaluation.protocol: Re-run this suite unchanged and compare per capability, not only the composite.
evaluation.guard: Hold out at least one task per capability, otherwise the improvement is memorisation of the suite.

caveats: The data volumes are planning heuristics declared in the harness configuration, not measured yields.
A single greedy run per task gives a point estimate; repeat with sampling before quoting a rate as a property of the model.
A capability band describes behaviour on this task suite and tool surface, which is narrow by construction.
Where a band rests on one task, treat the volume as a hypothesis to test with a pilot rather than a budget to commit.
